title: Companies Act, 2013 — Section 391 (Application of sections 34 to 36 and Chapter XX)

content.overview: Sections 34 to 36 apply to a prospectus issued under section 389 and to the issue of Indian Depository Receipts. Subject to section 376, Chapter XX applies mutatis mutandis to the closure of a foreign company's place of business in India where money raised under Chapter XXII remains unrepaid or securities remain unredeemed.
content.glance: ss. 34–36 apply to foreign prospectus/IDR; Chapter XX can apply to closing an Indian place of business in limited cases.
content.study: Section 391(1) applies prospectus liability provisions (ss. 34–36) to a prospectus under section 389 and to IDR issues. Section 391(2), subject to section 376, applies Chapter XX mutatis mutandis to closure of the place of business of a foreign company in India where the foreign company raised money through an offer or issue of securities under Chapter XXII and the money remains unrepaid or the securities remain unredeemed. It does not wind up the foreign company itself worldwide.

sections.heading: Prospectus liability extension
sections.body: ss. 34–36 apply to s. 389 prospectus and IDR issues.

sections.heading: Limited Chapter XX application
sections.body: Closure of Indian place of business where Chapter XXII-raised money remains unrepaid or securities unredeemed.

sections.heading: Boundary
sections.body: Does not itself wind up the foreign company outside India.

questionsAndAnswers.answer: I. Identify foreign prospectus/IDR or place-of-business closure facts. II. Apply ss. 34–36 or Chapter XX as applicable. III. Conclude.
